name: Four Seasons Resort Whistler
insider_take: Where alpine grandeur meets legendary Four Seasons service — Whistler's crown jewel sits ski-in/ski-out on Blackcomb Mountain, delivering year-round mountain magic unlike anywhere else in North America.
whats_special: One of the few truly ski-in/ski-out luxury resorts on Blackcomb Mountain, with direct slope access steps from the lobby The resort's outdoor heated pool and hot tubs offer a surreal après-ski experience — soak in steaming water while snowflakes fall around you Whistler Blackcomb is the largest ski resort in North America , boasting over 8,100 acres of terrain right at your doorstep The Spa at Four Seasons Whistler incorporates locally inspired treatments using Pacific Northwest botanicals and indigenous wellness traditions
pro_tip: Book a slope-side room on an upper floor for breathtaking views of Blackcomb's runs. In summer, request a mountain bike concierge session — Whistler's bike park is world-class and the hotel staff can set you up like a pro.
dont_miss: The Peak 2 Peak Gondola — a UNESCO-recognized engineering marvel connecting Whistler and Blackcomb peaks, just minutes from the resort Sidecut Steakhouse , the hotel's signature restaurant, known for its exceptional Canadian dry-aged cuts and stunning mountain views The charming Whistler Village Stroll — a lively, car-free pedestrian village packed with boutiques, dining, and après-ski culture, just a short walk away
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location on Whistler Mountain
Luxury Four Seasons service and amenities
cons: Can be crowded during peak ski season
